topics.title: What questions can you bring?
topics.intro: The session adapts to your questions. These are the most common situations.

portfolio.title: You already have a portfolio
portfolio.body: Am I too exposed on a few coins? Which risks are worth understanding better? We discuss the structure and concentration of your portfolio.

capital.title: You have available capital
capital.body: How should I prepare to enter the market? We discuss your goals, time horizon, and risks before you invest.

losses.title: You have losses in your portfolio
losses.body: What options do I have after a portfolio drop? We discuss your current situation and the implications of the decisions you're considering.

process.title: How it works
process.intro: From booking to our discussion, in three steps.

pay.title: Pay for the session
pay.body: Book online through Stripe, securely, in euro. The price is €200 for 60 minutes.

schedule.title: We set a date
schedule.body: After payment you receive a confirmation email. Message us on WhatsApp or email to fix the day and time.

session.title: Online session
session.body: We meet one-on-one online for 60 minutes, based on your questions and situation.

process.prepare: You can prepare a list of questions in advance that you want to cover in the hour.
